title: Turn the treasurer's notes into next season's club budget
person: The volunteer treasurer of a small rowing club preparing the budget for the annual meeting.
review: Income and costs match the notes, the membership fee and member count are inputs the totals follow, and the result is a surplus of 5,100.
revised_review: With 92 members the income is 111,400 and the result 13,500, following from the changed member count alone.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
No hidden rows, columns or sheets.
Every column of the table has one unique heading.
Every value in a column of numbers is stored as a number.
The fee and the member count sit in their own labelled cells; no formula types them in.
Income 103,000 (85 x 1,200 plus the sponsor's 1,000), costs 97,900, and a result of 5,100; the fee and member count are inputs the totals follow.
